title: Dorm overnight oats
description: Oats soaked in milk overnight with fruit, ready to grab before an 8 a.m. class.
ingredients: 1/2 diced apple or a handful of berries
steps: Stir oats, milk, yogurt, chia and cinnamon together in a jar.
Top with fruit, cover and refrigerate overnight.
Stir and eat cold, or microwave 1 minute.

title: Gochujang tofu rice bowl
description: Crispy pan-fried tofu glazed with gochujang over rice and quick vegetables.
ingredients: 1 block extra-firm tofu, pressed and cubed
steps: Pan-fry tofu in a little oil until golden on all sides, about 10 minutes.
Whisk gochujang, soy sauce, maple syrup and 1 tbsp water; toss with the tofu.
Serve tofu and vegetables over rice; top with sesame and scallions.

title: Black bean and corn quesadilla
description: A five-ingredient quesadilla that works in a pan or a sandwich press.
steps: Mash half the beans with a fork and spread on half the tortilla.
Add the rest of the beans, corn and cheese; fold.
Cook in a dry pan 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted.

title: Lemon chickpea salad
description: A no-cook salad that keeps in the fridge for three days.
steps: Combine chickpeas and vegetables in a bowl.
Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, salt and pepper; pour over.
Toss with parsley and chill 10 minutes before eating.

title: Leftover egg fried rice
description: Turns yesterday's rice into dinner in one pan.
steps: Scramble the eggs in an oiled pan and set aside.
Stir-fry the vegetables 2 minutes, then add the rice and break up clumps.
Add soy sauce and sesame oil; fold in the eggs and scallions.

title: Greek yogurt parfait
description: Layered yogurt, granola and fruit, built from the dining hall yogurt bar or your fridge.
steps: Layer half the yogurt, fruit and granola in a cup.
